name: Frangi
tagline: A personal AI agent for every hotel guest
description:
Frangi makes AI agents for hotels. Each guest gets a personal agent that knows them, plans their stay and keeps the plan up to date while they are there. It writes in the hotel's own voice.

Before the guest arrives, Frangi drafts a plan for their stay. It offers the right extras at the right moment, and when things change, it updates the plan to match. If a guest has a complaint, Frangi sends it to the right person on the team and follows up until it is resolved.

Frangi talks to guests on WhatsApp first, and on the other channels the hotel already uses, such as booking-site chat and email. It works alongside the hotel's current booking system, as long as that system has an API, like Cloudbeds.

The hotel's team stays in control. Frangi learns the hotel's voice, house rules and discount limits, and it works within them. It never invents prices, availability or services. The team reviews what matters and approves each plan before it goes to the guest, so every stay reflects how the hotel likes to look after its guests.

Frangi is a product by Morphal. Hotels can book a demo to see how it would work for them. https://frangi.ai/demo?utm_source=aiagentsinfo&utm_medium=directory
